Full-Day Outdoor Adventure Safari.Overview: Experience a thrilling outdoor adventure with quad biking, a camel ride in the desert, lunch by the sea, and exciting water sports on the beach.

Tour Itinerary.Hotel Pickup: Pickup from your hotel at 8:00 AM and a 20-minute drive to the Quad Biking station.
Quad Biking Adventure: Get instructions on how to use the quad bike, including safety measures.
Ride through the desert between mountains and Bedouin tents.
Short break at Echo Valley and rest at a Bedouin tent with traditional Bedouin tea.
Tour Itinerary.Camel Ride Experience: Enjoy a 20-minute camel ride through the desert.
Tour Itinerary.Lunch by the Beach: Drive back to the quad station, then head to the beach for a delicious lunch with soft drinks.
Water Sports & Beach Activities: Banana Boat Ride - Feel the thrill on this fun-filled ride.
Glass Bottom Boat - Explore the coral reefs and vibrant marine life.
Parasailing - Soar above the sea for stunning aerial views of Sharm El Sheikh.
Tour Itinerary.Hotel Drop-off: Return to your hotel at 4:00 PM.

Highlights: Quad Biking - Ride through the stunning desert landscape
Lunch on the Beach - Enjoy a meal with a view
Banana Boat Ride - Exciting water adventure
Glass Bottom Boat - Discover the underwater world
